# MyBingoCard.com

> MyBingoCard is a free online tool for creating custom bingo cards for any occasion — classrooms, parties, baby showers, weddings, team building, and more.

## What MyBingoCard Does

- Create custom bingo cards with your own words or images
- Choose from 30+ themed templates (baby shower, wedding, classroom, holiday, etc.)
- Generate 3x3, 4x4, or 5x5 grid sizes
- AI-powered card generation — describe your theme and get cards instantly
- Export to HD PDF or PNG for printing
- Share cards online with unique links
- Every viewer gets a uniquely shuffled card
- Host live multiplayer bingo games with real-time number calling
- Batch generate up to 500 unique cards at once

## Pricing

- Free: 1 card, 5 starter templates, standard PDF export with watermark
- Monthly: $4.99/month — unlimited cards, all templates, HD exports, AI generation, ad-free
- Lifetime: $14.99 one-time — same as Monthly, but you pay once and keep Premium forever
- 7-day free trial of Premium for all new signups

## Use Cases

- Teachers: vocabulary review, math facts, spelling, classroom rewards
- Baby showers: gift prediction bingo, baby item bingo
- Weddings: reception bingo, bridal shower bingo
- Parties: holiday parties, birthday parties, game nights
- Corporate: team building, icebreakers, onboarding, all-hands meetings
- Senior centers: activity bingo for elderly residents
- ESL/language learning: vocabulary bingo in any language
- Health & wellness: nutrition bingo, fitness bingo

## How It Works

1. Go to mybingocard.com/create
2. Add your words/phrases to the cells (or use AI to generate them)
3. Choose a grid size and template
4. Export as PDF, share a link, or host a live game

## Technical Details

- Built with Next.js and React
- Works on any device (desktop, tablet, phone)
- No app download required — runs in the browser
- Cards are unique per viewer (shuffled algorithm)
- Supports image-based bingo cards (upload your own photos)
